record.bible_text: And there was a famine<WH07458> in the land<WH0776>, beside<WH0905> the first<WH07223> famine<WH07458> that was in the days<WH03117> of Abraham<WH085>. And Isaac<WH03327> went<WH03212><WTH8799> unto Abimelech<WH040> king<WH04428> of the Philistines<WH06430> unto Gerar<WH01642>.

And Isaac<WH03327> dwelt<WH03427><WTH8799> in Gerar<WH01642>:

And Abimelech<WH040> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, What <FI>is<Fi> this thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804> unto us? one<WH0259> of the people<WH05971> might lightly<WH04592> have lien<WH07901><WTH8804> with thy wife<WH0802>, and thou shouldest have brought<WH0935><WTH8689> guiltiness<WH0817> upon us.

And Abimelech<WH040> charged<WH06680><WTH8762> all <FI>his<Fi> people<WH05971>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, He that toucheth<WH05060><WTH8802> this man<WH0376> or his wife<WH0802> shall surely<WH04191><WTH8800> be put to death<WH04191><WTH8714>.<CM>

Then Isaac<WH03327> sowed<WH02232><WTH8799> in that land<WH0776>, and received<WH04672><WTH8799> in the same year<WH08141> an hundredfold<WH03967><WH08180>: and the LORD<WH03068> blessed<WH01288><WTH8762> him. <RF>received: Heb. found<Rf>

And he went up<WH05927><WTH8799> from thence to Beersheba<WH0884>.

And the LORD<WH03068> appeared<WH07200><WTH8735> unto him the same night<WH03915>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, I <FI>am<Fi> the God<WH0430> of Abraham<WH085> thy father<WH01>: fear<WH03372><WTH8799> not, for I <FI>am<Fi> with<WH0854> thee, and will bless<WH01288><WTH8765> thee, and multiply<WH07235><WTH8689> thy seed<WH02233> for my servant<WH05650> Abraham's<WH085> sake.

Then Abimelech<WH040> went<WH01980><WTH8804> to him from Gerar<WH01642>, and Ahuzzath<WH0276> one of his friends<WH04828>, and Phichol<WH06369> the chief captain<WH08269> of his army<WH06635>.
